name: io.github.groove79/mcp-kakao
description: KakaoTalk message MCP: send to self/friends, friends list, OAuth auto-refresh. 카카오톡 메시지 MCP.
title: KakaoTalk Message

environmentVariables.name: KAKAO_REST_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Kakao Developers app REST API key

environmentVariables.name: KAKAO_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client secret, only if enabled in the app's Kakao Login settings

environmentVariables.name: KAKAO_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Alternative to the stored token file from `mcp-kakao auth`

environmentVariables.name: OKAGENT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OK Agent key (free at okagent.kr) — writes then wait for your OK on KakaoTalk. Unset: writes ask for confirmation in the chat first.

environmentVariables.name: KMCP_WRITE_MODE
environmentVariables.description: approval | confirm | direct (default: approval if OKAGENT_API_KEY is set, else confirm)
